descriptionMarkdown:
A book of space platform modules of varying widths as well as specific configurations of those modules into working vessels. Includes starter, basic inner system, Aquilo-capable and Edge of Solar System-capable classes. The basic inner system platforms can be upgraded from basic fuel/oxidizer recipes to advanced recipes in-place. None of the space platforms or modules in this book use any quality components.

Platforms are tested with all sciences (including the first level of infinite sciences) researched, which is:
* Weapon shooting speed 6
* Physical projectile damage 7
* Laser shooting speed 7
* Laser weapons damage 7
* Stronger explosives 7
* Railgun shooting speed 1
* Railgun damage 1
* Asteroid productivity 1

 You may need to adjust the throttle controls of the platforms if your science level does not match.

Each of the fully integrated vessel classes has a few features:
* Throttle control to manage speed via pump duty cycle.
* Auto-feed of initial fuel and oxidizer to reduce manual intervention requirements.
* Asteroid chunk thresholds to maintain an evenly balanced sushi belt.
* Pre-flight checklist combinator to simplify schedule conditions.

Version 1.0.3 adds a Block 3 Sprinter-class configuration that uses foundries and tier 3 assemblers in the ammo section.
title: Modular Space Platforms v1.0.3
